option_relations.rationale: Right ventricular infarction is a component of the broader diagnosis described in the leaf, which includes dextrocardia and inferior wall MI.

The option precisely matches the detailed diagnosis provided in the leaf, including mirror-image dextrocardia, acute inferior wall and right ventricular myocardial infarction, and the cause (proximal right coronary artery occlusion).

Acute inferior-lateral ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) is a component of the broader diagnosis described in the leaf, which also includes dextrocardia and the specific vessel occlusion.

Acute ST-elevation myocardial infarction due to proximal right coronary artery occlusion is a significant part of the diagnosis but omits the crucial finding of dextrocardia, making it a less complete description than the leaf.
